summary.plain: The international team of more than 700 scientists from 75 institutions in 17 countries and regions who built and run the JUNO neutrino experiment.
summary.technical: International collaboration operating the JUNO reactor-antineutrino oscillation experiment; per IHEP's November 2025 announcement, more than 700 scientists from 75 institutions in 17 countries and regions.
